button_key.note: Drawn as an ordinary button showing its label; it cannot capture a key binding.

field_enter_after_edit.note: Parsed and ignored, which is the whole behaviour on a non-Android client.

hypertext.note: Tags, styles, images, items and actions are rendered; hovercolor and vertical alignment are not.

model.note: The mesh is loaded with Luanti's own loaders, textured, posed at the frame loop and drawn in a SubViewport, honouring the initial rotation, continuous rotation, mouse control and a non-zero animation speed. A mesh whose media has not arrived falls back to a labelled placeholder. Style properties (noclip, bgcolor) are not applied.

scrollbaroptions.note: min, max, smallstep, largestep and thumbsize are applied. Godot's scrollbar draws no arrow buttons, so the arrows option has nothing to act on.

style.note: Colours, background images, borders, font size and list slot geometry are applied; font family and sound are not.

style_type.note: Colours, background images, borders, font size and list slot geometry are applied; font family and sound are not.

tablecolumns.note: text, image, color, indent and tree columns with align, width and tooltip; the padding option is ignored.

tooltip.note: Named and area tooltips work, but custom tooltip colours are ignored.
